meta.name: golang-testing
meta.description: Go testing best practices including table-driven tests, test helpers, benchmarking, race detection, coverage analysis, and integration testing patterns. Use when writing or improving Go tests.

copy.tagline: 用最佳实践编写和优化 Go 测试
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在写 Go 代码并想提升测试质量
copy.tagline_en: Write and improve Go tests with best practices
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write Go code and want to improve test quality

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照 Go 语言的最佳实践来编写和优化测试代码，包括表格驱动测试、测试辅助函数、基准测试、竞态检测、覆盖率分析和集成测试模式。
howto.when: 当用户要求编写或改进 Go 测试代码时触发，例如提到“写测试”、“提高覆盖率”或“调试测试”等。

say.text: 帮我写一个表格驱动的测试用例。
say.note: Claude 会生成表格驱动测试代码。

say.text: 如何检测 Go 代码中的竞态条件？
say.note: Claude 会解释并使用 -race 标志。

say.text: 为这个函数写一个基准测试。
say.note: Claude 会生成基准测试代码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will write and optimize Go test code following best practices, including table-driven tests, test helpers, benchmarking, race detection, coverage analysis, and integration testing patterns.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to write or improve Go tests, such as mentioning 'write tests', 'improve coverage', or 'debug tests'.

say_en.text: Write a table-driven test for me.
say_en.note: Claude will generate table-driven test code.

say_en.text: How to detect race conditions in Go?
say_en.note: Claude will explain and use the -race flag.

say_en.text: Write a benchmark for this function.
